RONI is a climate index, not an immediate disaster warning. A sustained pattern is not the same as an official NOAA outlook.
Check water supplies and heat exposure during dry, hot periods.

Follow official seasonal outlooks, not individual index readings.

For awareness only. Earthquakes cannot be predicted. Global event feeds and modeled forecasts are incomplete and may be delayed; scheduled Android checks cannot guarantee timely notifications. Follow official local emergency guidance.
Background checking is requested about every 15 minutes; Android may delay it. World feeds are for information, not emergency push alerts.

Live worldwide events. Local alerts where you choose.
Reports are not predictions or guaranteed emergency alerts. Follow local authorities.
NASA EONET lists selected observed natural events worldwide. It is not a complete disaster list, an early warning service or real-time emergency alert.
Recent global USGS reports (M4.5+). Notifications apply only to earthquakes around your selected location, not every world event.

Important: NASA EONET events, USGS earthquakes, NOAA climate indices and modeled weather/AQI are supplemental information. Event coverage varies worldwide and can be incomplete or delayed. The app does not predict earthquakes, issue official tsunami warnings, or guarantee urgent notifications. Use official alerts in your country.
Local alert settings apply to the chosen city and nearby reports; worldwide feeds are informational.

Recent worldwide event bulletins from GDACS. Reports may be delayed, revised or incomplete. Headlines are shown in the source language. Tap a bulletin to read the original report. These are not direct emergency push alerts.
